ja: 『装甲騎兵ボトムズ』特報！！
『装甲騎兵ボトムズ　ザ・ラストレッドショルダー』ターボザックと各種武装のオプションセットが登場！
『装甲騎兵ボトムズ ザ・ラストレッドショルダー』に登場時のスコープドッグ ターボカスタムを再現可能なオプションセット！
ターボザックと各種武装、ボーナス水転写デカールが付属！数々の特徴的な武装を新規造形で再現！
「1/20 スコープドッグ ターボカスタム」（別売）と組み合わせれば、キリコ達４人のＡＴを再現可能。※武装選択式
※ 本体等はこの商品に含まれません
この商品は、バンダイプラモデル「1/20 スコープドッグ ターボカスタム」（別売）に装着して楽しむ ‘武装’と‘オプションパーツ’です。
●　特徴的な武装を新規造形で再現！
『装甲騎兵ボトムズ ザ・レッドショルダー』で特徴的な、ガトリングガン、７連ミサイルポッドが接続できる

マルチディスチャージャー、２連ミサイルランチャー、アームガン、ハンドロケットランチャー等の印象的な武器や、
弾倉といった細部まで、新規成形パーツで徹底再現。
● 水転写デカール
新規デザインのコーションマークを収録したデザインの、ボーナス水転写デカールが付属。
●　キリコ機、グレゴルー機、ムーザ機、バイマン機を再現可能！

en: “Armored Trooper Votoms” special news! !
"Armored Trooper Votoms The Last Red Shoulder" Turbo Zac and various armed option sets are now available!
An option set that allows you to reproduce the Scope Dog Turbo Custom as it appeared in "Armored Trooper Votoms: The Last Red Shoulder"!
Includes turbo rucksack, various weapons, and bonus water transfer decals! Reproduce a number of distinctive weapons with new modeling!
If you combine it with "1/20 Scopedog Turbo Custom" (sold separately), you can reproduce the AT of Kiriko and the others. *Weapon selection formula
*The main unit etc. are not included in this product
This product is 'armed' and 'optional parts' that can be enjoyed by attaching it to Bandai Plastic Model "1/20 Scope Dog Turbo Custom" (sold separately).
● Reproduce the characteristic weapons with new modeling!
The Gatling gun and 7 missile pods featured in “Armored Trooper Votoms The Red Shoulders” can be connected.
Reproduce the Turbo Zac with new modeling.
Impressive weapons such as multi-discharger, dual missile launcher, arm gun, hand rocket launcher,
Every detail such as the magazine has been thoroughly reproduced with new molded parts.
● Water transfer decal
A bonus water slide decal with a newly designed caution mark is included.
● Chirico machine, Gregoru machine, Musa machine, and Byman machine can be reproduced!
If you combine it with "1/20 Scopedog Turbo Custom" (sold separately), you can reproduce the AT of Kiriko and the others!
*Weapon selection formula.
(To reproduce 4 aircraft, you will need 4 pieces each of this product and "1/20 Scopedog Turbo Custom" (sold separately).
In addition to the main body, some weapons are included with the main product. )
(Set contents)
・Turbo Zack x 1
・Solid shooter x1
・Hand rocket launcher x1
・7 missile pod x 1
・Gatling gun x 1
・Multi discharger x 1
・Dual missile launcher x 1
・Arm gun x 1
・Magazine (thin) x 4
(Compatible products) *Sold separately *In addition to the following, compatible with products that use the same main kit.
"1/20 Scopedog Turbo Custom" [Premium Bandai sales item]
1/20 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product materials: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
(remarks)
・This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・This product may be sold at events sponsored by our company or other projects, or overseas.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'. Please note that the item may be out of stock.
・Due to production availability, we are limiting the quantity of this product that can be purchased per person.
